card.name: Leading digit of 30, 60, 90 minutes
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 3, 6 or 9 right after 'over' or 'at least' in a timing phrase, where the next character is likely a 0 to make 30, 60 or 90 minutes.

modes.label: Infusion duration
modes.description: The digit starts the length of an intravenous infusion after 'over' or 'over approximately'.
modes.example: Administer TECENTRIQ as an intravenous infusion over <<6>>0 minutes.

modes.label: Wait before food or lying down
modes.description: The digit starts a minimum waiting time after 'at least' for oral drugs.
modes.example: Take LINZESS on an empty stomach, at least <<3>>0 minutes prior to a meal

card.writes: It pushes the model toward finishing a number with a zero or a tens-style number word, as in 30, 60 or 90.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a round time like 30, 60 or 90 minutes in dosing directions.
